description: Lets the hosted Duct web app call the keychain commands. Local dev origins live in the dev-only `dev-localhost` capability, which release builds exclude via app.security.capabilities. The `notification:*` entries are not for our own code, which notifies through the `notify` command: registering `tauri-plugin-notification` injects a `window.Notification` polyfill into every webview, and that polyfill invokes `is_permission_granted` on load. Without these it was denied, and the rejection surfaced as a runtime error on every page load.
